_comment: The keys the shipped iOS app decodes from a read-API record (HukamnamaEntry.CodingKeys in gurbani-soul-ios ios/App/Shared/HukamnamaShared.swift). They are frozen: a public record must carry each of them with this JSON type and, for published_at, this exact timestamp shape (no fractional seconds: the app decodes with .iso8601). status is a closed enum in the app.
